meta.name: ondb
meta.description: A logical analysis and reasoning tool for AI. Use when decomposing documents into structured knowledge, querying entities and relations, validating consistency, or indexing files. Trigger on "remember", "what do I know about", "link X to Y", "show dependencies", "analyze this document", entity CRUD, or cross-skill data access.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文档拆解为结构化知识并查询推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从文档中提取实体关系并做逻辑推理
copy.tagline_en: Decompose documents into structured knowledge and reason over it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relations from documents and perform logical reasoning

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以把文档、笔记等拆成结构化的实体和关系，存入一个可查询的图数据库。你可以让它记住信息、查找关联、验证逻辑一致性。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude“记住”某事、问“关于X我知道什么”、要求“把X链接到Y”、或说“分析这个文档”时触发。

say.text: 记住，项目A的截止日期是下周五。
say.note: Claude 会创建一个实体并存储属性。
Claude 会查询并返回该实体的信息。
Claude 会在两者之间建立关系。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can decompose documents, notes, etc. into structured entities and relations, stored in a queryable graph database. You can ask it to remember information, find associations, and verify logical consistency.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to "remember" something, ask "what do I know about X", request "link X to Y", or say "analyze this document".

say_en.text: Remember, project A's deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: Claude will create an entity and store the property.

say_en.text: What do I know about Alice?
say_en.note: Claude will query and return the entity's info.

say_en.text: Link task T1 to project P1.
say_en.note: Claude will create a relation between them.
